div.p: Every person who signs in to AFENDA xForge is a user record. A user belongs to one or more groups, and groups are what grant access to an app.
Open Settings, then Users, then New. Enter a name and an email address; the email address is the login. Save, then use Send Password Reset Instructions so the person sets their own password.
On the user form, each installed app offers a level of access. Leave an app blank to hide it from that user entirely.
